title: Zindaa ke andhere me matam hai sakina ka
body:
HAYE SAKINA… HAYE SAKINA… ZINDAN KEY ANDHERE MEIN MATAM HAI SAKINA KA
JITNA BHI KARE MATAM YEH KAM HAI SAKINA
GOUHAR JO SITAMGAAR NE BEREHMI SE CHEENA HAI
KAANAO SE LAHU QATRE BAN BAN KEY TAPAKTA HAI
<<DIVIDER>>
YE DOUR-E-YATEEM MEIN…..
YE DOUR YATEEM MEIN, AALAM HAI SAKINA KA
HAYE SAKINA… HAYE SAKINA… ZALIM KEY TAMACHE HAI OUR KHAAK PE SONA HAI
AB USKE MUQADDAR MEIN ZINDA KA ANDEHRA HAI
<<DIVIDER>>
DAMAN-E-QABA KHOON SE…..
DAMANE-E-QABA KHOON SE, PURNAM HAI SAKINA KA
HAYE SAKINA… HAYE SAKINA… KURTE SE KABHI APNA MUU DHAAP KE ROTI HAI
GHARBRA KEY KABHI DHUKIYA SAJJAD SE KEHTI HAI
<<DIVIDER>>
AB QATM MERE BHAIYYA…..
AB QATM MERE BHAIYYA, YE GHAM HAI SAKINA KA
BABA KO SAKINA NE JO QUAB MEIN DEKHA HAI
MILNE KO SAR-E-SARWAR KHUD QAID MEIN AYA HAI
<<DIVIDER>>
MEHMAAN KOI DAM KA….
MEHMAAN KOI DAM KA, AB DAM HAI SAKINA KA
HAYE SAKINA… HAYE SAKINA… TASVEER NEGAHOU MEIN PHIRTI HAI SAKINA KI
MAJLIS JO KAHI BARPA HOTI HAI SAKINA KI
<<DIVIDER>>
HAR DIL MEIN AZA KHANA…..
HAR DIL MEIN AZA KHANA, QAYAM HAI SAKINA KA
RONE SE SAKINA KO TASKEEN SI HOTI HAI
AWAZ SISAKNE KI ZINDAN SE AATI HAI
<<DIVIDER>>
YE ASHK-E-AZA LOGA…..
YE ASHK-E-AZA LOGO, MARHAM HAI SAKINA KA
HAYE SAKINA… HAYE SAKINA… HATIF KI SADA AAYI PURDAD YE MAZHAR KO
PURSA DO SAKINA KA ABBAS KO SARWAR KO
<<DIVIDER>>
JE BHAR KEY KARO MATAM…..
JEE BHAR KEY KARO MATAM, YE GHAM HAI SAKINA KA
